notes.title: The game will be retired - We need a fresh start and your help is fundamental!
notes.content:
Hello guys.

On December 2nd [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820480/Pact_of_the_Ancients__3D_Bara_Survivors]Pact of the Ancients[/url] will complete 2 months of launching. Since 2019 until now I launched a lot of games and none of them had such terrible first months as Pact. [b]It's by far Male Doll's worst project when we talked about revenue and one of the most expensive ones when we consider the investment[/b]. I could tell you the reasons but in the end, it's my fault to allow this project to be launched, especially when it wasn't entirely designed by me.

I know you all are disappointed with the final result and I've been thinking a lot about how to fix this. So [b]here are the steps I plan to work on in the next months[/b]:

1) [b]The game will be hidden/removed from the store[/b]: It has terrible reviews, Steam's algorithm has punished us for that (and for its revenue) and the more people buy it, the more people tend to be disappointed with the game and with Male Doll. Also, to deliver new and fun gameplay in the way we imagined we need time to work on the project. If it is still available in the store, we need to stop our work to explain the same thing to everyone.

2) [b]Gameplay will be remade[/b]: soulslike game has a core mechanic and Pact of the Ancients should have it fully. We'll clone the basic aspects of Vampire Survivors and put our own NSFW flavor on it. But for soulslike fans, they will have the essence of the game that is the main reference of the genre.

3) [b]Features will be tested by our Discord players after they are implemented[/b]: if you bought the game on Steam and want to help us make a good remake of it, please join Discord to be notified about the project improvements. We hope to launch a build per month to remove all possible bugs and to test all features properly.

4) [b]The new game (Pact of the Ancients 2.0) will probably start as an Early Access[/b]: We received a lot of feedback from Itch.io but Steam has a lot more 'soulslike players'; we need them to improve the game quality! So, even though Male Doll has a niche audience and we need to charge more for our games to be able to pay the investment, Pact will follow the conventions of Steam soulslike games. In other words, the new game will probably cost no more than 5~6 dollars. We hope when we finish it, we can recover our investment through console sales.

5) [b]The 200 people who bought it will receive special rewards and/or will receive a key for the new game[/b]: I'm not sure yet how we will do that (maybe a form) but we won't allow people who bought the first game to buy it again without being rewarded for supporting us in the first moment.

I hope we can deliver everything you expect from us.

Thank you so much for your patience and support.

Victoria Invicta
CEO of Male Doll

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is back - Temporary Maintenance
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm dropping by to say to you all that my team and I are completely aware of the many bugs [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820480/Pact_of_the_Ancients__3D_Bara_Survivors/]Pact of the Ancients[/url] have. To create visual novel moments with full voice-over we implemented a Unity template that we used to work for our novels and we adapted it to support a huge gameplay moment. However, this template didn't work as we planned and basically all bugs and negative reviews we have been receiving are being caused by it. 

We know how to fix that and the answer is quite simple: we are remaking the gameplay! The moments you buy a skill/equipment, the lewd animations you have during the gameplay, the chests that release a portion of the story, and then a CG; EVERYTHING is being remade.

We tried to keep our schedule and bring more content but it's not possible to enjoy it when you find so many bugs. So I decided to return to the last stable version of the game and suspend the updates while we work on a major update to fix everything you've been reporting to us. We hope to release it by December 18th (as I said, we are remaking A LOT OF THINGS) and we hope you understand our situation. This game was a huge step for us and as a small studio with only 1 programmer dedicated to the game, there is not much we can do to speed it up.

Thank you all for your patience and we hope the major update can give us the experience we want to provide you.

Victoria Invicta
CEO of Male Doll Studio

We're so excited to announce a new update to Pact of the Ancients! Check out what has changed.

3 new SFW collectable scenes, involving 3 couples: 
[list]
[*] Gladiator and Demon(collectable in the Goblin Hideout)
[*] Gladiator and Barbarian(collectable in the Pirate Island)
[*] Gladiator and Satyr(collectable in the Viking Village)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/6afad2592a7ee8dd3878efe1b2fa2599c7dc2c87.png[/img]
As you saw on the game road map available on the Steam page, we would have 5 but to focus on fixing bugs as soon as possible, we had put our efforts into that and we decided to make scenes involving couples instead of individual scenes. If you find any bugs, feel free to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/4y4bwRh]Discord[/url] to report them and/or use the game forum.

notes.title: Exploring the gameplay
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Today we've come to talk a bit more about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820480/Pact_of_the_Ancients__3D_Bara_Survivors/]Pact of the Ancients'[/url] gameplay mechanics, which you'll get a closer look during the livestream we'll be hosting here on Steam on August 1st. Especially for those who haven't had any contact with the game yet, we invite you to play the demo available on game's page!

We can start by saying that each character has an initial active skill that sets them apart in terms of gameplay, especially during the first few minutes of the game. This mechanic creates diversity and introduces distinct playstyles, as each initial skill offers unique advantages and limitations. You'll be able to play with all the characters as you unlock them and experience different ways of playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/bb17ba06db5db7a81ca54cac69cf6000df68c776.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/248cdfcd13c52d933aec425f5daa266d5a46f56f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/ecc681ff6b889f7717af62624d98c06f39c82f56.png[/img]

There will be more than 10 different options of active abilities that can be upgraded, in addition to the initial active skill. Each ability can be upgraded up to level 10 as you collect XP gems. Choose wisely, as you can equip up to 4 of them per playthrough!
Additionally, there will be general attributes that can be individually upgraded later on, such as intelligence, lethality, speed, strength, and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/73ab68f231a00b8bb650c1392188fe252b6e5cd8.png[/img]

As you advance in the game, the monster hordes grow denser and more resilient, leading to progressively intense challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/35f546df9ba5da1af15d496d1e26b768f6759190.png[/img]

The player itself has no maximum level. In other words, survive as long as you can, and you'll become increasingly stronger! 

Moreover, you'll be able to collect achievements as you progress through your runs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/40210be424006d63e617c7a73b9917ea1925c51a.png[/img]

One more glimpse of the game's visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/e1e3ae99cfada3740f2312f68dce7fc4a14ecff6.png[/img]

We hope this summary has sparked your interest to see it all up close in our livestream on August 1st! Add[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820480/Pact_of_the_Ancients__3D_Bara_Survivors/] Pact[/url] to your steam wishlist and join us on our [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/562351737181306881/915567363196321792]Discord channel[/url] to stay tuned on everything.

notes.title: Development Note - Magnet Implemented
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today we're going to talk about another update in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820480/Pact_of_the_Ancients__3D_Bara_Survivors/]Pact of the Ancients[/url] development.

We're introducing a brand new attribute called Magnet - that may be familiar to veterans of Vampire Survivor and similar games. With Magnet, drop items will be irresistibly drawn towards the player, making looting and collecting a breeze!

The Magnet attribute functions as a powerful tool that significantly enhances the player's ability to gather XP Gems and treasures. No longer will you need to walk around. The Magnet will do the hard work for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41903262/b310b6c53f52f1ce1593f8e46ce069b6767a8868.png[/img]

This attribute will have a default standard value to all playable characters, and may be increased by appropriate equipments and powerups. It will prove certainly very useful to plow through the hordes of enemies!

As well as Magnet, we also plan to bring in several other familiar faces to improve the gameplay dynamics of the game. Behind the scenes, we're working on new attribute systems called Range, Area, and Amount. Can you guess what they do? They will help further differentiate weapons and characters from each other; and maybe even have new characters that have unique abilities woven into them...

Along with everything else, we are also making a hard effort to rebalance the math of skills, powerups and equipment, aiming to make the game simple, while still being fun. We look forward to showing you all this soon!

Keep an eye out for the next updates, add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820480/Pact_of_the_Ancients__3D_Bara_Survivors/]Pact[/url] to your Steam wishlist, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/4y4bwRh]Discord channel[/url] to get the builds firsthand

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820480/Pact_of_the_Ancients__3D_Bara_Survivors/
